description: Search/filter Los Angeles building permits, or look up permits by permit number, property address, or contractor.

appToken.description: Optional free Socrata app token to raise API rate limits. Get one at https://data.lacity.org/profile/app_tokens. Not required — the actor works without it.
appToken.title: Socrata app token (optional)

assessorBook.description: LA County Assessor's Identification Number (AIN) "Book" component. Example: `2405`.
assessorBook.title: Assessor book (mode=byAssessorParcel)

assessorPage.description: LA County Assessor's Identification Number (AIN) "Page" component. Example: `003`.
assessorPage.title: Assessor page (mode=byAssessorParcel)

assessorParcel.description: LA County Assessor's Identification Number (AIN) "Parcel" component. Example: `032`.
assessorParcel.title: Assessor parcel (mode=byAssessorParcel)

contractorName.description: Exact contractor business name in mode=byContractor (e.g. `OWNER-BUILDER`); substring filter in mode=search.
contractorName.title: Contractor business name

initiatingOffice.description: Filter to a single LADBS district office that issued the permit.
initiatingOffice.title: Initiating office

issueDateFrom.description: Drop permits issued before this date.
issueDateFrom.title: Issue date from (YYYY-MM-DD)

issueDateTo.description: Drop permits issued after this date.
issueDateTo.title: Issue date to (YYYY-MM-DD)

maxStories.description: Drop permits with more stories than this.
maxStories.title: Max number of stories

maxValuation.description: Drop permits with a higher declared construction valuation than this.
maxValuation.title: Max valuation (USD)

minResidentialUnits.description: Drop permits with fewer residential dwelling units than this.
minResidentialUnits.title: Min residential dwelling units

minStories.description: Drop permits with fewer stories than this.
minStories.title: Min number of stories

minValuation.description: Drop permits with a lower declared construction valuation than this.
minValuation.title: Min valuation (USD)

nearLatitude.description: Latitude of a center point. Combine with `nearLongitude` (and optionally `radiusMeters`) to return only permits within a radius of this point. Example: `34.0522` (downtown LA). Both nearLatitude and nearLongitude must be set for this filter to apply.
nearLatitude.title: Near latitude (geo-radius search)

nearLongitude.description: Longitude of a center point. Combine with `nearLatitude` (and optionally `radiusMeters`) to return only permits within a radius of this point. Example: `-118.2437` (downtown LA).
nearLongitude.title: Near longitude (geo-radius search)

occupancy.description: Filter to a single building-code occupancy classification. Only populated on a minority of permits (mostly new construction / major alterations) -- most permits omit this field entirely.
occupancy.title: Occupancy group

permitCategory.description: Filter to a single review category.
permitCategory.title: Permit category

permitNumbers.description: Exact PCIS permit numbers to fetch. Example: `20010-30000-00390`.
permitNumbers.title: Permit numbers (mode=byPermitNumbers)

permitSubType.description: Filter to a single building-use sub-type.
permitSubType.title: Permit sub-type

permitType.description: Filter to a single top-level permit type.
permitType.title: Permit type

radiusMeters.description: Search radius around `nearLatitude`/`nearLongitude`, in meters. Only used when both are set. Defaults to 500m.
radiusMeters.title: Radius (meters)

status.description: Filter to a single current permit status.
status.title: Status

statusDateFrom.description: Drop permits whose latest status change is before this date.
statusDateFrom.title: Status date from (YYYY-MM-DD)

statusDateTo.description: Drop permits whose latest status change is after this date.
statusDateTo.title: Status date to (YYYY-MM-DD)

streetDirection.description: Filter to a single street direction prefix.
streetDirection.title: Street direction

streetName.description: Street name, without direction/suffix. Example: `HARVARD`. Exact match in mode=byAddress; substring match as a filter in mode=search.
streetName.title: Street name

streetSuffix.description: Filter to a single street-suffix abbreviation.
streetSuffix.title: Street suffix

workDescriptionKeyword.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the permit's work description. Example: `swimming pool`.
workDescriptionKeyword.title: Work description contains

zipCodes.description: Restrict results to one or more 5-digit LA zip codes. Example: `90047`.
zipCodes.title: Zip codes

title: Los Angeles Building Permits Scraper Input
